members.author: claygeo

members.title: fix(client): preserve authorization server subpath in fallback URLs
members.author: claygeo
members.reason: [llm pick] cluster primary for issue #1716: Both PRs have unknown CI status and touch the same number of files (3), so neither wins on CI or diff size alone. The deciding factor is technical approach: #1724 throws an error on non-root AS paths, which is a breaking behavior change for any client already using a subpath-based authorization server. #1832 preserves the subpath in the fallback URL, which correctly propagates the full AS path without rejecting the configuration. For issue #1716 (about fallback URL construction losing the AS subpath), preserving the subpath is the more targeted and correct fix — it resolves the root cause rather than failing fast on a case the client may legitimately encounter. #1724 is older and would otherwise win on the age tiebreaker, but the approach difference outweighs seniority here.
